svg.title: Exact Turing instability band and three logically distinct certificate outcomes
svg.desc: For the stated Schnakenberg model, determinant 0.1(q−2)(q−5) is negative exactly for 2<q<5 while trace stays negative. Endpoints q=2 and5 are neutral. Hypothetical eigenvalue intervals with epsilon0.2 illustrate: one entire interval strictly inside the band proves original instability; all intervals strictly outside the closed band exclude unstable and neutral modes; otherwise the outcome is inconclusive. Checking one outside interval never proves stability.

g.text: trace(J − qD) = −0.2 − 1.1q < 0; q = 2 and 5 are neutral, not strictly stable.
Intervals are schematic (ε = 0.2). A no-instability conclusion checks every mode and excludes neutral endpoints.
